item.title: Mother dead, son in custody after Fort Worth stabbing
item.description: A woman is dead, and her adult son is in police custody after a stabbing in north Fort Worth on Friday night. Fort Worth fatal stabbingThe incident happened around 9 p.m. Friday in the 4800 block of Cargill Circle. Fort Worth officers say they arrived to find a woman with stabbing wounds. She was pronounced dead at the scene. Her adult son was found nearby and taken into custody. The man was taken to a nearby hospital for a wound that police say may have been self-inflicted. item.title: Wood County deputy, DPS trooper in critical condition after officer-involved shooting
item.description: A standoff in Wood County ended in gunfire Sunday morning after a suspect who allegedly shot two law enforcement officers late Saturday was killed during a breach of his home, authorities said.
